post.description:
## Create Task

Use this endpoint to create a new image-to-image generation task.

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
  After submission, use the unified query endpoint to check task progress and retrieve results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend providing the `callBackUrl` parameter so your service can receive completion notifications instead of polling for task status.
:::

## Related Resources

model.description: The model name used for generation. This field is required. This endpoint must use the `gpt-image-2-image-to-image` model.

callBackUrl.description: Callback URL for task completion notifications. Optional parameter. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes, whether it succeeds or fails. If omitted, no callback notification will be sent. To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification).

input.description: Input parameters for the image-to-image task.

examples: Transform this product image into a premium e-commerce poster style.

aspect_ratio.description:
The aspect ratio of the generated image is set to auto by default.
Note: for 2K resolution, the following aspect ratios are not supported: 5:4, 4:5, 3:1, 1:3, and 9:21.
for 4K resolution, the following aspect ratios are not supported: 3:1, 1:3, and 9:21.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 1K, 2K or 4K. Set this field explicitly. 2K does not support 5:4, 4:5, 3:1, 1:3 or 9:21; 4K does not support 3:1, 1:3 or 9:21. The background parameter is only available at 1K.

background.description:
Image background
Note: This parameter is only supported when the resolution is 1K.

input.prompt: take a photo with Sam Altman in the conference room

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description upon failure

taskId.description: The task ID can be used with the "Get Task Details" endpoint to query the task status.

post.description: Sent when the task succeeds or fails.

code.description: 200: success. 501: failure; see data.failCode and data.failMsg.

completeTime.description: Task completion time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

createTime.description: Task creation time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks.

model.description: Image editing model used for the task

param.description: Parameters submitted when creating the task, in JSON string format
param.example: {"input":"{\"aspect_ratio\":\"auto\",\"prompt\":\"take a photo with Sam Altman in the conference room\",\"input_urls\":[\"https://static.aiquickdraw.com/tools/example/1776782793756_wrogXTdd.png\"]}","callBackUrl":"https://your-domain.com/api/callback","model":"gpt-image-2-image-to-image"}

resultJson.description: Image generation result in JSON string format. resultUrls contains the list of generated image URLs. Present only when state is success.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

failCode.description: Failure code, a numeric string such as "400" or "500". Present only when state is fail.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.
